about: How every Edge CMS site is set up. A person reads it as a checklist; the edge-site-setup skill works from it as its plan. Each item: the rule, how it is set (`set`), how it is checked (`check`: readiness codes that must be absent, or `answers` fields the site must match), and whether a person must do it. scripts/standards-report.mjs evaluates it against a readiness report, the draft site and the answers.

items.rule: The site has an existing theme (or a new one made for it).
items.set: theme.create or an existing theme id; site.create theme

items.rule: A new site is created on the placeholder domain <site-slug>.test; the real domain is set by a person at launch (edge-site-launch).
items.note: Readiness warns site.placeholder-domain until launch; that warning is expected during setup.

items.rule: The site has its logo: an image logo (and a light version when the theme has dark headers), or a text logo with its text.
items.set: site.settings logo, logoLight, logoType, logoText, brandLogoDark, brandLogoLight (Hub media URLs)

items.rule: The site has a favicon and an app icon.
The site has its contact email and phone; forms without their own recipient send to the contact email.
The social links the site owner has are set, as full URLs.
items.set: site.settings socialFacebook, socialInstagram, socialTwitter, socialLinkedIn, socialYouTube, socialTikTok

items.rule: Tracking ids that exist are set; consent stays on with the standard message unless the owner says otherwise.
items.set: site.settings trackingGoogleAnalytics, trackingFacebookPixel, trackingAdroll, trackingAdrollPixelId, trackingConsentEnabled, trackingConsentMessage
items.note: A Google Analytics property that doesn't exist yet is created or linked by a person at launch.

items.rule: The site has a meta title, a meta description and WebSite structured data with its tokens.
items.set: site.create settings or site.update metaTitle, metaDescription, structuredData

items.rule: The default pages chosen at the start exist, made from the theme's templates, each with content.
items.set: site.create (seeds the theme's default menus), page.create for pages the theme lacks

items.rule: Every page is in a menu, or deliberately in Not In Menu; menu titles and order are the owner's.
The site chrome (synced navigation and footer) is on every page.
items.set: page.placeBlock with the synced block (no values)
items.note: Synced values (navigation links, footer text) are edited by a person in the Hub; list what they need in the report.

items.rule: Every page has a meta title, a meta description and structured data with its name and description filled.
Every image is in the Hub's media; none is linked from another site.
items.set: cms_upload_media, then the Hub URL in values and settings

items.rule: Every form reaches a recipient: its own emailTo, or the site's contact email.
Every placed block passes the Hub's checks and its required values are filled.
items.set: page.setValues; block.draft for a block's own problems

items.rule: A person reviews the draft site, releases block drafts and publishes the pages and site settings in the Hub.
